description: After explicit confirmation, remove a postcard email from the review queue and delete its stored email/artwork with id and confirmed:true. Requires production write access. Read review.canDelete and deleteReason first. In-flight preparation/payment/mailing blocks deletion; completed orders remain in job history. Unpaid checkouts expire atomically. The original mailbox email is unchanged. Retry the same id safely.
name: delete_email_postcard

outputSchema.description: Read operation first for financial/mail state and recovery. Optional service fields are absent on failure. Unknown is not zero or permission to retry. Legacy service fields remain available.

amountCents.description: USD cents. Null means not applicable or not known; never interpret null as zero.
